dialogue.content: おはようございます。時間になったら始めていきます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good morning. We'll begin now. I look forward to speaking with you.

dialogue.content: (こちらこそよろしくお願い致します)
dialogue.English: (I look forward to it as well.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。はじめに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 20代　主婦2歳の息子がいます近所のママ友にストレスが溜まっているのですが、どうすれば角を立てずに関わりを断てますか？
dialogue.English: I'm in my twenties, a homemaker, and I have a two-year-old son. I'm feeling stressed because of a neighborhood mom friend—how can I cut off contact without causing friction?

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: ママ友との関係にストレスを感じているのですね。もう少し具体的に教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see you're feeling stressed about your relationship with this mom friend. Could you tell me a bit more specifically?

dialogue.content: しょっちゅう家に遊びに来るので、困っています更には、、
dialogue.English: She comes over to my house all the time, and it's a problem. Furthermore,...

dialogue.content: ママ友の子供が、おもちゃを投げたり、横取りしたりしても注意をしません
dialogue.English: Her child throws and snatches toys, but she doesn't say anything to correct them.

dialogue.content: 非常識なんです
dialogue.English: She's so inconsiderate.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。危ないのに注意をしてくれないのは困ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be difficult when she doesn't correct her child's dangerous behavior.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しょっちゅう遊びに来るとはあなたの時間お構いなしにということですか？
dialogue.English: When you say she comes over all the time, do you mean she does so without any regard for your schedule?

dialogue.content: その通りです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 非常識なので　困っています
dialogue.English: She's so inconsiderate, and it's causing me problems.

dialogue.content: あなたにもご都合がおありでしょうから、お構いなしにというのは困りますよね。
dialogue.English: You have your own schedule, so it must be troubling to have her come over without any consideration for that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ママ友が家に来た時にはどう思われるのですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel when this mom friend comes to your home?

dialogue.content: もう、嫌でたまりません
dialogue.English: I just can't stand it anymore.

dialogue.content: それほどお辛いのですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like it's that distressing for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう、関わりたくありません
dialogue.English: I don't want anything to do with her anymore.

dialogue.content: それでも招き入れていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: And yet, you still let her in?

dialogue.content: 家まで来ていて、やんわり断っても　家の子が遊びたいって言うから〜って言われたら　強く言えませんよね
dialogue.English: She comes right to my door, and even if I try to refuse gently, she'll say something like, "But my child wants to play," and then I can't say no firmly.

dialogue.content: そうですね、子どもも一緒だとなかなか断りにくいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's difficult to say no, especially when the children are there.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ママ友が家にいて一緒に過ごしている時はどのようなお気持ちでお過ごしなのですか？
dialogue.English: When she's at your home and you're spending time together, how do you feel?

dialogue.content: もう、嫌でたまりません
dialogue.English: I just can't stand it anymore.

dialogue.content: 嫌なのにずっと我慢して過ごされてきたのですね。お辛かったですよね。
dialogue.English: So even though you can't stand it, you've been enduring it this whole time. That must have been very hard for you.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ママ友と今後どのようにお付き合いしていきたいですか？
dialogue.English: How would you like to handle your relationship with this mom friend going forward?

dialogue.content: 付き合いたくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want a relationship with her.

dialogue.content: 角を立てずに関わりを断ちたいです
dialogue.English: I want to cut ties without causing any friction.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 角を立てずに、
dialogue.English: Without causing friction,

dialogue.content: なるべくトラブルは避けたいとお考えなのですね
dialogue.English: you'd like to avoid trouble as much as possible.

dialogue.content: そうです今後、幼稚園、小学校と顔を合わせることを考えると角を立てたくありません
dialogue.English: That's right. Considering we'll be seeing each other at kindergarten and elementary school down the line, I don't want to cause friction.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、ママ友であれば今後子ども関係で顔を合わせることもありますものね。
dialogue.English: Right. Since you're both mothers, you'll likely see each other at child-related events in the future.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: ママ友が家に来た時にどのような対応ができたらいいな等考えたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you thought about how you would ideally like to respond when she comes to your house?

dialogue.content: 非常識な人には、何をどう伝えたらいいのか　困っていますが、、、強くも言えません
dialogue.English: I'm at a loss as to what to say or how to say it to someone so inconsiderate... and I can't be firm about it.

dialogue.content: 非常識と思われるのは、お構いなしに来たり、注意をしないから
dialogue.English: What makes you feel she's inconsiderate is that she comes without regard and doesn't correct her child...

dialogue.content: まだまだ、色々あります
dialogue.English: There's much, much more.

dialogue.content: そのほかにも非常識と感じるようなことはありましたか？
dialogue.English: Are there other things you find inconsiderate?

dialogue.content: 他にもおありなのですね
dialogue.English: So there are other things, then.

dialogue.content: おもちゃは、持って帰ってしまう　返してくれなくて無くなってしまったり謝らない、片付けて帰らない
dialogue.English: She lets her child take toys home, they don't get returned and end up lost, she doesn't apologize, and she doesn't clean up before she leaves.

dialogue.content: その他　とにかく関わりたくないです
dialogue.English: Among other things... I just don't want anything to do with her.

dialogue.content: そのようなことがあったのですね、
dialogue.English: I see—those things have happened.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは非常識と思うのも自然なことですよね
dialogue.English: It's only natural that you would find that inconsiderate.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 相手にどう伝えたらいいか困っているとおっしゃっていましたが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're having trouble figuring out how to tell her...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 具体的に何か伝えたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you said anything specific to her?

dialogue.content: 伝え方が、困っていると会うよりは　関わりたくないのです。具体的に、と言われても今日は、ちょっと、、、とか、子供の調子が、、、とか　そう伝えても向こうは関係ない人ですから伝え方をどうやっても本当に強く言わない限り無理かと思いますでも、角を立てたくないんです
dialogue.English: Rather than struggling with how to tell her, I'd rather just not interact with her at all. Even if you ask me to be specific, I've tried saying things like, "Today isn't a good day..." or "My child isn't feeling well..." but she's the type of person who doesn't care. I feel like unless I say it really strongly, it's useless. But I don't want to cause any trouble.

dialogue.content: 強く言わないと伝わらない、
dialogue.English: It won't get through unless you speak firmly,

dialogue.content: でも強く言うと角が立ってしまう
dialogue.English: but if you speak firmly, it will cause friction.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えですか？
dialogue.English: Is that how you see it?

dialogue.content: そうでしょうね非常識な人なので、伝わったら、激怒しそうですし
dialogue.English: Probably. Since she's inconsiderate, if it did get through, she might fly into a rage.

dialogue.content: その通りです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: あなたの困っている状況やお気持ちを伝えても
dialogue.English: Even if you try to convey your difficult situation and your feelings...

dialogue.content: 非常識ですから
dialogue.English: She's inconsiderate.

dialogue.content: それが伝わらず、自分のことしか考えず怒ってしまいそうなのですね
dialogue.English: ...it won't get through to her, and she'll only think of herself and get angry.

dialogue.content: その通りです
dialogue.English: That's exactly right.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 伝えたい、変えたい気持ちがあるのに相手が怖くて言えないという感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does it feel like you want to tell her and change the situation, but you're too afraid of her reaction to say anything?

dialogue.content: と、言うよりは先程もお伝えしましたがもう、関わりたくないんです
dialogue.English: It's more like... as I said before, I just don't want to interact with her anymore.

dialogue.content: とにかく関わりたくないそのお気持ちの方が強いのですね
dialogue.English: So that feeling of just not wanting to interact with her is stronger.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 関わりを断ちたいんです
dialogue.English: I want to cut ties.

dialogue.content: 関わりたくないお気持ちの方が強いのであれば、一度はっきりと伝えてみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If your feeling of not wanting to interact is that strong, how about trying to tell her that clearly one time?

dialogue.content: ご近所なので、、、それができたら、とっくにやっています
dialogue.English: Because we're neighbors... If I could do that, I would have done it long ago.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、関わりたくないけど強く言うと
dialogue.English: Right—you don't want to be involved, but if you speak strongly,

dialogue.content: 今後を考えるから　できないんです
dialogue.English: Thinking about the future, I can't do it.

dialogue.content: 角が立つのではと思ってなかなか言えないですよね
dialogue.English: It's hard to say it because you worry it will cause friction.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どちらの気持ちも大事だから言いたいけど言えないそんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: Both feelings are important, so you want to say it but can't—is that how it feels?

dialogue.content: そんなことはないです
dialogue.English: That's not it.

dialogue.content: 私の方が、ストレス限界なんです
dialogue.English: I'm the one who's at my breaking point with stress.

dialogue.content: どちらの気持ちもというのが関わりたくないと角を立てたくないという気持ちです
dialogue.English: When I said "both feelings," I meant the feeling of not wanting to interact and the feeling of not wanting to cause trouble.

dialogue.content: 言葉が足らず失礼しました
dialogue.English: I apologize for not being clear.

dialogue.content: 関わりたくありません
dialogue.English: I don't want to be involved.

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: No, no, it's fine.

dialogue.content: ちなみに今まではママ友との関係でストレスが溜まったらどのように発散されているのですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, when stress builds up from this relationship, how do you usually relieve it?

dialogue.content: ママ友が帰った後など
dialogue.English: For example, after she leaves.

dialogue.content: 溜まる一方です
dialogue.English: It just keeps building up.

dialogue.content: 育児や家事に追われてストレス発散できる時間なんてありません
dialogue.English: I'm so busy with childcare and housework that I don't have time to relieve stress.

dialogue.content: 溜まる一方、それは我慢の限界にもなってしまいますね
dialogue.English: If it just keeps building up, it's understandable that you would reach your limit.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 子育てしているとなかなか自分の時間作るのも難しいですよね
dialogue.English: It's hard to make time for yourself when you're raising a child, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ママ友との関係で困っている事を
dialogue.English: Regarding the problems you're having with your mom friend...

dialogue.content: 今まで誰かに相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: have you ever talked to anyone about this before?

dialogue.content: 主人には言いましたが、右から左で、流されてしまいます
dialogue.English: I told my husband, but it just went in one ear and out the other. He just brushes it off.

dialogue.content: ご主人に話してみたこともあるのですね、聞いてもらいたかったのにしっかり聞いてもらえないのは嫌ですよね
dialogue.English: So you have tried talking to your husband. It must be upsetting when you want someone to listen, but they don't really hear you.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: そろそろ時間なのでまたお話が出来たらと思います。
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up, so I hope we can talk again soon.

dialogue.content: 今日はおはなしされてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.content: なにも、解決できていないので、なんとも言えません
dialogue.English: We haven't solved anything, so I can't really say.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、お力になれずすみません。
dialogue.English: I see. I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつでもここではお話しすることができるので
dialogue.English: You can always talk here,

dialogue.content: ストレスが爆発する前に一緒に解決策を見つけられたらと思います
dialogue.English: and I hope we can find a solution together before your stress explodes.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話を聴かせてくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing with me today.

dialogue.content: はい、では次回またよろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Okay, then I look forward to our next session.

dialogue.content: 何かお力に少しでもなれたらと思うのでまたいつでもご相談ください。
dialogue.English: I hope I can be of even a little help, so please feel free to reach out anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: それでは終了させていただきます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Then we will end the session here. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
